usageNote: fantastic在这里不是'幻想'而是'超赞'！口语里常用来夸景色超级震撼，带点兴奋感！

examples.en: The cruise ship offered fantastic views of the icebergs drifting in the Arctic Ocean.
examples.zh: 游轮提供了北冰洋漂流冰山的壮观景色。

examples.en: We woke up early just to enjoy the fantastic views of the icebergs at sunrise.
examples.zh: 我们一大早起床，就为了欣赏日出时冰山的壮丽景色。
